chapterTitle: Chapter 7: Chemical Equilibrium & Le Chatelier's Principle

questions.question: The equilibrium constant (K) depends on:
questions.explanation: Correct answer: 'Temperature'. According to Federal Board Class 11 Chemistry principles of Chemical Equilibrium & Le Chatelier's Principle.

questions.question: At equilibrium, the rates of the forward and reverse reactions are:
questions.explanation: Correct answer: 'Equal'. According to Federal Board Class 11 Chemistry principles of Chemical Equilibrium & Le Chatelier's Principle.

questions.question: The reaction quotient (Q) is used to compare:

options.A: The rate of the forward reaction
options.B: The concentrations of reactants and products at any time
options.C: The equilibrium constant with the rate constant
options.D: The energy of reactants and products

questions.explanation: Correct answer: 'The concentrations of reactants and products at any'. According to Federal Board Class 11 Chemistry principles of Chemical Equilibrium & Le Chatelier's Principle.

questions.question: A reaction at equilibrium will shift towards the products if:

options.A: The concentration of reactants is increased

questions.explanation: Correct answer: 'The concentration of reactants is increased'. According to Federal Board Class 11 Chemistry principles of Chemical Equilibrium & Le Chatelier's Principle.

questions.question: If the volume of the system is reduced, the equilibrium will shift towards:
questions.explanation: Correct answer: 'Fewer moles of gas'. According to Federal Board Class 11 Chemistry principles of Chemical Equilibrium & Le Chatelier's Principle.

questions.question: For the reaction: N₂(g) + 3H₂(g) ⇌ 2NH₃(g), if the temperature is increased, the equilibrium will:
questions.explanation: Correct answer: 'Shift to the left'. According to Federal Board Class 11 Chemistry principles of Chemical Equilibrium & Le Chatelier's Principle.

questions.question: A catalyst affects the equilibrium by:
questions.explanation: Correct answer: 'Increasing the rate of reaction'. According to Federal Board Class 11 Chemistry principles of Chemical Equilibrium & Le Chatelier's Principle.

questions.question: The equilibrium constant for a reaction only changes when:
questions.explanation: Correct answer: 'The temperature changes'. According to Federal Board Class 11 Chemistry principles of Chemical Equilibrium & Le Chatelier's Principle.

questions.question: Le Chatelier’s principle helps predict the direction of shift when:

options.D: The concentration of a product is decreased

questions.explanation: Correct answer: 'The temperature changes'. According to Federal Board Class 11 Chemistry principles of Chemical Equilibrium & Le Chatelier's Principle.

questions.question: For a system at equilibrium, if the concentration of products is increased, the equilibrium will shift:
questions.explanation: Correct answer: 'To the left'. According to Federal Board Class 11 Chemistry principles of Chemical Equilibrium & Le Chatelier's Principle.

questions.question: The equilibrium constant for a reaction is always:
questions.explanation: Correct answer: 'Dependent on concentration'. According to Federal Board Class 11 Chemistry principles of Chemical Equilibrium & Le Chatelier's Principle.

questions.question: If the concentration of a reactant is decreased, the equilibrium will shift towards:
questions.explanation: Correct answer: 'The products'. According to Federal Board Class 11 Chemistry principles of Chemical Equilibrium & Le Chatelier's Principle.

questions.question: If a gas-phase reaction has more moles of reactants than products, increasing the pressure will shift the equilibrium:
questions.explanation: Correct answer: 'To the left'. According to Federal Board Class 11 Chemistry principles of Chemical Equilibrium & Le Chatelier's Principle.

questions.question: For an exothermic reaction, decreasing the temperature will shift the equilibrium:
questions.explanation: Correct answer: 'To the right'. According to Federal Board Class 11 Chemistry principles of Chemical Equilibrium & Le Chatelier's Principle.

questions.question: A system at equilibrium can be disturbed by:

options.A: Changing the concentration of reactants or products

questions.explanation: Correct answer: 'All of the above'. According to Federal Board Class 11 Chemistry principles of Chemical Equilibrium & Le Chatelier's Principle.

questions.question: If the reaction quotient Q is greater than the equilibrium constant K, the reaction will shift:
questions.explanation: Correct answer: 'To the left'. According to Federal Board Class 11 Chemistry principles of Chemical Equilibrium & Le Chatelier's Principle.

questions.question: The concentration of reactants at equilibrium is:

options.A: Always greater than that of products
options.B: Always equal to that of products

questions.explanation: Correct answer: 'Variable, depending on the reaction'. According to Federal Board Class 11 Chemistry principles of Chemical Equilibrium & Le Chatelier's Principle.

questions.question: A decrease in the concentration of products will shift the equilibrium towards:
questions.explanation: Correct answer: 'The products'. According to Federal Board Class 11 Chemistry principles of Chemical Equilibrium & Le Chatelier's Principle.

questions.question: If the equilibrium constant for a reaction is large, it means the reaction favors:
questions.explanation: Correct answer: 'The products'. According to Federal Board Class 11 Chemistry principles of Chemical Equilibrium & Le Chatelier's Principle.

questions.question: The equilibrium constant expression for a reaction is:

options.B: Based only on the concentrations of solids
options.C: Always written in terms of concentrations of gases and solutions

questions.explanation: Correct answer: 'Always written in terms of concentrations of gases and'. According to Federal Board Class 11 Chemistry principles of Chemical Equilibrium & Le Chatelier's Principle.

questions.question: If the temperature is increased for an exothermic reaction, the equilibrium will shift:
questions.explanation: Correct answer: 'To the left'. According to Federal Board Class 11 Chemistry principles of Chemical Equilibrium & Le Chatelier's Principle.

questions.question: The equilibrium constant (K) for a reaction is affected by:
questions.explanation: Correct answer: 'Temperature'. According to Federal Board Class 11 Chemistry principles of Chemical Equilibrium & Le Chatelier's Principle.

questions.question: For a reaction at equilibrium, if Q > K, the reaction will shift:
questions.explanation: Correct answer: 'To the left'. According to Federal Board Class 11 Chemistry principles of Chemical Equilibrium & Le Chatelier's Principle.

questions.question: In the reaction: N2 + 3H2 ⇌ 2NH3, increasing the concentration of N2 will shift the equilibrium:
questions.explanation: Correct answer: 'To the right'. According to Federal Board Class 11 Chemistry principles of Chemical Equilibrium & Le Chatelier's Principle.

questions.question: If a catalyst is added to a system at equilibrium, it will:
questions.explanation: Correct answer: 'Increase the reaction rate'. Catalyst speeds up both forward and reverse rates equally; Kc and equilibrium position unchanged.

questions.question: For a reaction with more moles of gas on the reactant side, decreasing the volume will shift the equilibrium:
questions.explanation: Correct answer: 'To the left'. According to Federal Board Class 11 Chemistry principles of Chemical Equilibrium & Le Chatelier's Principle.

questions.question: In a system at equilibrium, increasing pressure will shift the equilibrium towards:
questions.explanation: Correct answer: 'Fewer moles of gas'. According to Federal Board Class 11 Chemistry principles of Chemical Equilibrium & Le Chatelier's Principle.

questions.question: For a reversible reaction at equilibrium, decreasing the concentration of a product will shift the equilibrium:
questions.explanation: Correct answer: 'To the right'. According to Federal Board Class 11 Chemistry principles of Chemical Equilibrium & Le Chatelier's Principle.

questions.question: The value of the equilibrium constant for a reaction depends on:
questions.explanation: Correct answer: 'The temperature'. According to Federal Board Class 11 Chemistry principles of Chemical Equilibrium & Le Chatelier's Principle.

questions.question: When Q = K for a reaction, the system is:
questions.explanation: Correct answer: 'At equilibrium'. According to Federal Board Class 11 Chemistry principles of Chemical Equilibrium & Le Chatelier's Principle.

questions.question: At equilibrium, the rate of the forward reaction is:

options.A: Greater than the rate of the reverse reaction
options.B: Equal to the rate of the reverse reaction

questions.explanation: Correct answer: 'Equal to the rate of the reverse reaction'. According to Federal Board Class 11 Chemistry principles of Chemical Equilibrium & Le Chatelier's Principle.

questions.question: The equilibrium constant (K) for a reversible reaction is dependent on:
questions.explanation: Correct answer: 'The temperature'. According to Federal Board Class 11 Chemistry principles of Chemical Equilibrium & Le Chatelier's Principle.

questions.question: If the concentration of a reactant is increased, the position of equilibrium will:

options.D: Depends on the type of reaction

questions.explanation: Correct answer: 'Shift to the right'. According to Federal Board Class 11 Chemistry principles of Chemical Equilibrium & Le Chatelier's Principle.

questions.question: In an exothermic reaction, increasing the temperature will:

options.A: Shift the equilibrium to the left
options.B: Shift the equilibrium to the right
options.C: Have no effect on the equilibrium
options.D: Increase the value of the equilibrium constant

questions.explanation: Correct answer: 'Shift the equilibrium to the left'. According to Federal Board Class 11 Chemistry principles of Chemical Equilibrium & Le Chatelier's Principle.

questions.question: A reaction at equilibrium can be disturbed by changing:

options.A: The concentration of reactants or products

questions.explanation: Correct answer: 'All of the above'. According to Federal Board Class 11 Chemistry principles of Chemical Equilibrium & Le Chatelier's Principle.

questions.question: According to Le Chatelier's Principle, if the pressure is increased in a system with gases, the equilibrium will shift towards:

options.A: The side with more moles of gas
options.B: The side with fewer moles of gas
options.C: The side with equal moles of gas

questions.explanation: Correct answer: 'The side with fewer moles of gas'. According to Federal Board Class 11 Chemistry principles of Chemical Equilibrium & Le Chatelier's Principle.

questions.question: The equilibrium constant for a reaction that produces solid products is:

options.C: Dependent on the concentration of solids
options.D: Not dependent on the concentration of solids

questions.explanation: Correct answer: 'Not dependent on the concentration of solids'. According to Federal Board Class 11 Chemistry principles of Chemical Equilibrium & Le Chatelier's Principle.

questions.question: For a reaction to be in equilibrium, the rates of the forward and reverse reactions must:
questions.explanation: Correct answer: 'Be equal'. According to Federal Board Class 11 Chemistry principles of Chemical Equilibrium & Le Chatelier's Principle.

questions.question: If the value of the equilibrium constant (K) is very large, the reaction is:
questions.explanation: Correct answer: 'Almost complete, favoring products'. According to Federal Board Class 11 Chemistry principles of Chemical Equilibrium & Le Chatelier's Principle.

questions.question: The reaction: will be favored if the pressure is:
questions.explanation: Correct answer: 'Increased'. According to Federal Board Class 11 Chemistry principles of Chemical Equilibrium & Le Chatelier's Principle.

questions.question: In a reaction involving gases, decreasing the volume will:

options.A: Shift the equilibrium to the side with fewer moles of gas
options.B: Shift the equilibrium to the side with more moles of gas
options.C: Have no effect on the equilibrium

questions.explanation: Correct answer: 'Shift the equilibrium to the side with fewer moles of gas'. According to Federal Board Class 11 Chemistry principles of Chemical Equilibrium & Le Chatelier's Principle.

questions.question: If the equilibrium constant (K) for a reaction is very small, the reaction is:
questions.explanation: Correct answer: 'Reactant favored'. According to Federal Board Class 11 Chemistry principles of Chemical Equilibrium & Le Chatelier's Principle.

questions.question: The equilibrium constant is:
questions.explanation: Correct answer: 'Dependent on temperature only'. According to Federal Board Class 11 Chemistry principles of Chemical Equilibrium & Le Chatelier's Principle.

questions.question: In the equilibrium expression, pure solids and liquids:

options.D: Are only included in the denominator

questions.explanation: Correct answer: 'Are excluded'. According to Federal Board Class 11 Chemistry principles of Chemical Equilibrium & Le Chatelier's Principle.

questions.question: In an exothermic reaction, increasing the temperature will:

options.D: Increase the rate of the reverse reaction

questions.explanation: Correct answer: 'Decrease the yield of products'. According to Federal Board Class 11 Chemistry principles of Chemical Equilibrium & Le Chatelier's Principle.

questions.question: The value of the equilibrium constant for a reaction:

options.A: Remains constant only at constant temperature
options.C: Depends on the concentrations of reactants
options.D: Is the same for all reactions

questions.explanation: Correct answer: 'Remains constant only at constant temperature'. According to Federal Board Class 11 Chemistry principles of Chemical Equilibrium & Le Chatelier's Principle.

questions.question: The equilibrium constant expression for a reaction involving only liquids and gases is:

options.A: Concentration of reactants divided by concentration of products
options.C: Products divided by reactants raised to their stoichiometric coefficients
options.D: The sum of products and reactants

questions.explanation: Correct answer: 'Products divided by reactants raised to their'. According to Federal Board Class 11 Chemistry principles of Chemical Equilibrium & Le Chatelier's Principle.

questions.question: The effect of adding a catalyst to a reaction at equilibrium is:

options.A: To increase the rate of the forward reaction only
options.B: To increase the rate of the reverse reaction only
options.C: To shift the equilibrium towards the products
options.D: To increase the rate of both the forward and reverse reactions equally

questions.explanation: Correct answer: 'To increase the rate of both the forward and reverse'. According to Federal Board Class 11 Chemistry principles of Chemical Equilibrium & Le Chatelier's Principle.

questions.question: A system is at equilibrium. If the concentration of one reactant is increased, the equilibrium will:

options.D: Increase the rate of the reverse reaction

questions.explanation: Correct answer: 'Shift to the right'. According to Federal Board Class 11 Chemistry principles of Chemical Equilibrium & Le Chatelier's Principle.

questions.question: The reaction reaches equilibrium at a given temperature. If the volume is reduced, the equilibrium will shift towards:

options.A: The side with fewer moles of gas
options.B: The side with more moles of gas

questions.explanation: Correct answer: 'The side with fewer moles of gas'. According to Federal Board Class 11 Chemistry principles of Chemical Equilibrium & Le Chatelier's Principle.
